prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: production animation SPRITE ATLAS, four sequential frames of ONE holographic orbital ring, on true transparent alpha.
Input image 1: reference/edit target for the original orange holographic orbital ring design, thin optical glass, intricate fine details and warm emission. Preserve this same circular object throughout the animation, with a fixed straight-on camera, identical scale, fixed circular silhouette and exact alignment in every cell. Make the ring thinner and more airy while retaining its fine optical details.
Output layout: SQUARE canvas, exactly TWO COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of equal square cells, with no drawn grid or borders. Reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Each cell contains the SAME ring perfectly centered, occupying only the central 60% of that cell, leaving 20% completely transparent padding on every side of each ring including its glow. No element may cross its cell; central vertical and horizontal gutters must be truly empty transparent. Four complete rings, none clipped.
Animation: four successive motion phases of the same object. A dominant group of brilliant broken orbital arcs and fine bright dashes travels clockwise around the rim: top-left phase 0 degrees concentrated near top; top-right phase 90 degrees concentrated near right; bottom-left phase 180 degrees concentrated near bottom; bottom-right phase 270 degrees concentrated near left. The faint circular base and camera remain stationary; only the luminous arc group rotates by exactly a quarter-turn per frame. All structural details, ring thickness and outer geometry remain consistent. Seamless cyclic sequence, no different designs or variants.
Palette: luminous orange #ff9d45 and amber #ffbf69 with restrained warm ivory highlights, subtle warm bronze glass shadows. NO cyan, blue or purple.
Transparency: true transparent background and all gutters; the hollow CENTER of every ring must be completely EMPTY TRANSPARENT, at least 55% of the ring's diameter. No center orb, glow, dot, lines or haze, no floor, no backdrop, no checkerboard.
Constraints: exactly four production animation frames, no contact-sheet presentation elements, no UI, no text, labels, numbers, logos, watermark, frames, borders or captions. Preserve fine rich original detail, complete centered circular rings and empty transparent padding. This is an actual sprite atlas to be split into four animated PNG frames.
limitations: The generated 2x2 grid is usable but rings occupy more than the requested 60% of each cell and contain faint diffuse alpha around rims and in apertures. Strict padding and fully empty aperture requirements were not met. Native clipping during frame export is needed for exact production bounds.
Second generation had worse overlap between cells and was discarded.
